🔥🇲🇽 <u>MEXICO PULLS 63 CUSTOMS PERMITS IN FUEL-SMUGGLING PURGE</u>

Mexico has stripped 63 customs agents of their permits over ties to "huachicol fiscal" — fuel slipped into the country under false declarations to dodge taxes — Sheinbaum said, crediting a new Customs Law that makes agents jointly liable for any crime at the border. The FGR is already prosecuting two former Navy commanders, the Farías Laguna brothers, over one such smuggling network.

US MAINSTREAM: Sheinbaum’s Second Informe — 68% approval, record gross FDI, homicides down
September 1, 2026 | 💀

📰 A 67-minute address: ~$35B gross FDI in H1 2026, 60M+ jobs, 2.7% unemployment, inflation ~3.1%, homicides down sharply, 68% approval. US mainstream ran almost nothing — the one Reuters angle picked the weakest number: net new FDI of $654M, “the weakest April–June reading since 2014.”

🇲🇽 A top US trading partner’s president reports two years of results; the US wire lead was investment “stalls” amid USMCA uncertainty.

• 68% approval; homicides at their “lowest since 2016”
• US wire framing: new foreign investment “stalls”

REUTERS: Mexico presses US on auto, steel tariffs in meeting with Lutnick
September 2, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Marcelo Ebrard met Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick in Chapel Hill, pressing for relief from 25% auto and 50% steel/aluminum tariffs. Reuters ran it straight — quoting Mexico’s position that the metal tariffs are “unjustified” and cut against integrated North American supply chains.

🇲🇽 The sticking point: Washington demands 50% US-specific content in vehicles; Mexico rejects it as a precedent that only tightens.

• Mexico calls the steel/aluminum tariffs “unjustified”
• US demand: “50% US-specific content in vehicles”

KVUE/STATESMAN: US citizen deported to Mexico after a Texas traffic stop is back home
September 1, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Brian Morales, 25, born in Denver — Social Security card, birth certificate, hospital records — was a passenger in a Fredericksburg tinted-window stop, held 5 days, and flown to Tabasco. DHS still “maintains Morales is not a U.S. citizen.”

💀 Officers called ICE to “translate,” then held him. He signed expedited removal to reach his wife and newborn; four months later his lawyers brought him back.

• “birth certificate showing he was born in Denver”
• DHS says he “admitted to entering the country illegally”

UPI/REUTERS: Mexican forces kill Los Reyes leader “El Wicho,” target of a $3M US reward
September 1, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Acting on Omar García Harfuch’s military intelligence, the Mexican army and National Guard killed Luis Enrique Barragán Chávez (“El Wicho” / R5) in Tocumbo, Michoacán. UPI’s headline leads with the “$3M US reward” — the trigger was Mexican intelligence, not Washington.

🇲🇽 He coordinated extortion of Michoacán’s avocado growers; his predecessor “Poncho” was arrested Aug 1. A Mexican-led operation, sold as a US bounty payoff.

• “target of a reward of up to $3 million”
• “military intelligence led the Mexican army and National Guard”

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Analysts Keep Raising Mexico's Growth Forecast</u>

Private analysts surveyed by the Bank of Mexico raised their 2026 GDP forecast to 1.25%, up from 1.11%, after INEGI confirmed the economy grew 2.1% year-on-year in the second quarter — its strongest quarter since 2020. The upgrade lands despite Trump's tariff barrage, the exact collapse Washington kept predicting and Mexico keeps refusing to have.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Opposition Told It Can't Call Itself 'Mexico'</u>

Mexico's electoral tribunal stripped the new opposition party 'Somos México' of its name, ruling that branding a party as the nation itself was a 'symbolic appropriation of national identity.' The coalition of ex-PAN, PRI and PRD figures is now just 'Somos,' must compete alone in 2027, and needs 3% of the vote to keep its registration. A party that claimed to be Mexico, told by law that it isn't.

🇲🇽🎓 <u>Veracruz Opens a Public Tourism School</u>

Veracruz has opened the state-run Escuela Veracruzana de Servicios Turísticos, enrolling its first 128 students in English, Veracruzan gastronomy, hotel operations and tour design — a curriculum built with seven regional tourism zones and backed by paid internships. Public investment training locals to run their own tourism economy, not just wait tables in it.

🇲🇽🦟 <u>Mexico Cuts Dengue Cases in Half</u>

IMSS logged 17,304 dengue cases through mid-2026 — a 50% drop from the 27,534 recorded a year earlier, with hospitalizations down to 2,479. Epidemiological surveillance coordinator Adriana Toriz linked the surge risk to climate-driven mosquito breeding, as the institute rolls out repellent-infused paint in Chiapas clinics — public health treating prevention as a right.

🇲🇽🕊️ <u>Homicides Down 51% Under the 4T</u>

In her Second Report, Sheinbaum announced intentional homicides have fallen 51% since she took office — 44 fewer killings every single day — with July 2026 posting the lowest daily average in 11 years. The result of attacking root causes, consolidating the National Guard and building intelligence, not the failed militarized 'war' Washington spent two decades demanding.
